nodes.name: Medium: create draft (official API)
nodes.notes:
Medium API: https://github.com/Medium/medium-api-docs
1. Get token at: medium.com/me/settings/security → Integration tokens
2. Set as Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN in credentials
3. Get YOUR_MEDIUM_USER_ID by GET https://api.medium.com/v1/me with token

nodes.name: LinkedIn: post link share
nodes.notes:
LinkedIn API: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/integrations/community-management/shares/ugc-post-api
1. Create LinkedIn app at developer.linkedin.com
2. OAuth flow → get access token with w_member_social scope
3. Get YOUR_LINKEDIN_USER_ID from /v2/userinfo endpoint
